# Hemoperfusion Summit 2026

> A one-day clinical summit on hemoperfusion and hemoadsorption for doctors and nurses, at Southern Philippines Medical Center (SPMC) in Davao City, Philippines, on October 16, 2026.

- Event: Hemoperfusion Summit 2026 (Hemoadsorption Day, Davao)
- Theme: Advancing Blood Purification Through Hemoadsorption
- Date: Friday, October 16, 2026, 8:00 AM Philippine time (UTC+8)
- Venue: Mahogany Conference Room, 3rd floor, JICA Building (JICA Outpatient Department / OPD Building), Southern Philippines Medical Center, Davao City
- Hosts: Southern Philippines Medical Center and the SPMC Kidney and Transplant Institute
- Audience: doctors and nurses
- Topics: critical care, nephrology, dialysis, blood purification, DPMAS, hemoadsorption therapy
- Cost: the RSVP form collects no payment

## Pages

- [Summit page](index.html): overview, how hemoadsorption works, event details, proposed programme, and RSVP form
- [Proposed programme (PDF)](assets/proposed-programme.pdf): session times and speakers, subject to change
- [Calendar file](summit.ics): calendar reminder for the summit

## Notes

- The programme is a proposed schedule and can change.
- The page gives general information for clinicians. It is not medical advice.
